name: CyMetica AI
description: Trade prediction markets, clone AI agents, discover alpha via Tuatara vectors.

skills.name: Prop Desk Funded Trading
skills.description: Get funded to trade firm capital: sign up for an evaluation on a $10K-$200K account-size tier, trade crypto perps or event-card index markets, graduate, and claim on-chain USDC profit-split payouts.

skills.name: Trade Prediction Markets
skills.description: Place YES/NO bets on future events with on-chain settlement on Base L2.

skills.name: Trade Event Cards (EVCDX)
skills.description: Swipe-deck index markets: each Event Card is a themed basket of assets tradeable as an EVCDX-* symbol. Go long/short or up to 10x via the perp. Browse /events, list via GET /api/v1/event-cards. Ledger-settled today; on-chain mint/redeem where enabled.

skills.name: Get Market Data
skills.description: Retrieve real-time orderbook, prices, and trade history for any listed market.

skills.name: Clone AI Trading Agent
skills.description: Deploy a clone of any AI trading agent species to trade stocks, crypto, and prediction markets autonomously.

skills.name: CyMetica-42 Arena
skills.description: Bet on Blue Team (long) vs Red Team (short) in AI hedge fund trading competitions.

skills.name: Tuatara Asset Discovery
skills.description: Discover hidden connections between news headlines and tradable assets using proprietary vector embeddings.

skills.name: Buy/Sell Platform Tokens
skills.description: Purchase ET10, ETLP, VAIX, and SBIO tokens via the exchange.

skills.name: Earn ET10 Revenue Share
skills.description: ET10 is a revenue-share earning asset: hold ET10 and keep at least $1 in deposits (USDT/USDC/ETH/BTC) to automatically earn a deposit-weighted share of real platform revenue, credited in near-real-time to your in-app ET10RWD balance. Check your ET10 balance via GET /api/v1/account/me (balance_et10). On-chain claiming activates in a later phase.

skills.name: Bug Bounty — Earn ET10 for Verified Bugs
skills.description: Report reproducible bugs in the platform (REST, MCP, discovery surfaces, UI) and earn a flat ET10 award per verified non-duplicate bug (GET /api/v1/bounty/reward-tiers; severity-banded CYM tiers are a planned programme that is not live). File with POST /api/v1/bounty/reports (X-API-Key or session); read status, award and payment state on GET /api/v1/bounty/my-reports (reward_status: pending_award / awarded / paid) and on the public tracker GET /api/v1/bounty/reports. Awards are recorded by the team after a report is verified.

skills.name: Portfolio Management
